name: Banyan Tree Bintan
short_description: An all-villa Banyan Tree resort in Lagoi with a private beach, championship golf course, and Balinese-style hillside villas, 55 minutes from Singapore.
ai_summary: Banyan Tree Bintan is an all-villa resort in Lagoi, on Bintan's Laguna Bintan Resort strip, roughly 55 minutes by ferry from Singapore. Villas are decorated in traditional Balinese style, raised on stilts and set on hillsides, with South China Sea views. Facilities include a private beach, an undulating championship golf course, and an acclaimed luxury spa. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
